display_name: Yetter, Homologically Twisted Invariants Related to State-Sum TQFTs
scope_note: David N. Yetter's 1993 arXiv note on homologically twisted refinements of Turaev-Viro and Crane-Yetter style state-sum invariants. This is a reference subject only; no theorem from it is admitted here.
upstream_review_hints: Useful as a primary reference for the phrase homologically twisted invariants.
Do not treat this subject as proof of our component-character-twist implementation without page-level extraction.
